title: Can We Test It?
text: Direct tests are hard. Craig Hogan proposed that a holographic graininess of space might show up as a tiny jitter.
nxt: In twenty fifteen, the Holometer at Fermilab did not see the jitter that his particular model predicts, and that ruled the model out.
